physiological_equivalent_description: Resistance to CSF absorption (Rout) - the quantity a lumbar infusion study measures directly. Elevated in normal-pressure hydrocephalus and IIH; abnormally LOW suggests a CSF leak, an open shunt, or a mis-specified cranial/spinal absorption split. Computed as the parallel combination of the cranial (0.069) and spinal (0.931) routes.
caveat: No healthy controls exist in this dataset - all four recordings are ICU patients. Healthy bounds are from literature, not from a control group measured with this pipeline.
